lines.speaker: gus
lines.text: Summer's hot because we're closer to the Sun.

lines.speaker: vera
lines.text: Here's the real orbit. Almost a circle.

lines.speaker: vera
lines.text: It's the tilt. Whichever half leans toward the Sun gets summer.

lines.speaker: vera
lines.text: Closer to a fire feels warmer. But Australia has summer in December.

lines.speaker: vera
lines.text: Seasons come from the tilt, not the distance.
